title: Stop generated merge conflicts
objective: Open sibling PRs must not conflict on generated manifests or on a shared doctrine paragraph. After one PR merges, remaining heads stay MERGEABLE without a human regen cycle. Stack-safe merge must not close a child by deleting the parent branch.
success_criteria: Two fixture PRs that do not share source files do not both list environment/program-execution/MANIFEST.json or skill-registry.json in gh pr view --json files.
governance-self-check on a PR whose changed files are only ops/scripts/foo.py does not fail because PE MANIFEST.json is stale.
lint-autofix.yml on push to main runs sync_generated_artifacts.py --force --pe-manifest and opens a cleanup PR when content drifts; it never pushes to protected main.
stack_safe_merge.py --run of a parent with an open child does not DELETE the parent ref; the child stays open and base-retargetable.
A feature PR that does not add a .plan.md does not trip kernel_gate plan kernel_pass.
